---
description: Implement an accepted task with regression tests and evidence.
agent: CATES SDLC
---

Implement the user's accepted task or issue contract. Reuse existing components.
Add a failing regression test when practical, make the smallest complete change,
update directly related documentation, and run targeted tests followed by
`npm run verify`. Inspect the final diff. Return evidence against each acceptance
criterion, actual validation results, compatibility risks and a PR description
using the repository template. Do not push, merge or publish without authorization.
